title: Pizza Order Discount Bug
symptomOutput: Order over $30 resulted in $40 instead of $30.
explanation: The discount was added to the total bill instead of subtracted on line 6. In financial calculations, discounts must reduce the total cost. Always verify arithmetic operators when applying reductions.
hints: Examine how the discount is applied to the total after the threshold check.
Check if the arithmetic operation increases or decreases the final bill.
Should a discount of 5 dollars increase 35 to 40 or reduce it to 30?

title: Arcade Score Accumulator Bug

tests.description: Multiple matches per player requiring score accumulation

explanation: The loop assignment `scores[player] = score` on line 5 overwrote previous scores instead of accumulating them. To calculate an average across multiple entries, total scores must be summed before dividing by the count. Using `scores.get(player, 0) + score` correctly preserves historical totals.
hints: Inspect what happens inside the loop when a player has multiple entries.
Compare how scores[player] is updated versus how counts[player] is updated.
Does line 5 add to the player's total score or replace it completely?

title: Delivery Route Fuel Accumulator Bug
symptomOutput: Route exceeding fuel capacity returned 1 instead of 0.
explanation: The recursive call passed `current_fuel` unchanged on line 6 rather than adding `distances[current_index]`. When tracking resource constraints recursively, state values must accumulate at each step. Adding the leg distance ensures routes exceeding capacity are correctly pruned.
hints: Trace how current_fuel changes across recursive calls.
Look at the 4th argument passed to count_valid_routes on line 6.
Is the fuel cost of the current leg (distances[current_index]) being added to current_fuel?
